prompt: Camera holds still. The woman nudges the joystick with small, careful pushes; up in the glass case the silver claw glides along its overhead rail, its coiled cable swaying, travelling across above the pile of little houses and coins until it hovers over the white two-storey house with the red roof. The man keeps his finger pointing at the white house and leans closer to the glass, coffee cup in his other hand. She bites her lip and leans in too. Their faces stay as they are, lit by the machine. Sound: whirring gantry motor, joystick clicks, distant arcade machines chiming over a low room hum.
